newsitem.title: GREECE: TEB OK'D FOR 3.04BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: TEB OK'D FOR 3.04BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Greek construction firm TEB got shareholder approval for a 3.036 billion drachma rights issue on Friday.
The terms will be one new registered share per two outstanding at 1,100 drachmas each.
The ex-rights date was not disclosed as the rights issue requires Athens bourse approval.
TEB will also double the par value of its stock to 250 drachmas, capitalising asset revaluation and share premium reserves totalling 690 million drachmas.
Its management told shareholders at the annual general meeting that the uncompleted portion of its order book is valued at 50 billion drachmas.
This includes BOT projects for the Elefsis-Stavros-Spata ringroad and the Rio-Antirrio suspended bridge, for which it carries out preliminary works valued at 11.7 bilion drachmas.
A dividend per share of 100 drachmas for fiscal 1996 was declared, unchanged from the previous year.
The stock will trade ex-dividend June 23.
TEB's 1996 pretax fell 10 percent to 1.04 billion drachmas on turnover growth of 29 percent to 8.31 billion drachmas.
Its shares firmed 35 drachmas to 1,780 on Friday in thin trading of 5,060 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
